title: Virtual Exchange in International Teaching
main_content: Virtual Exchange in International Teaching HTW Berlin supports teachers and students wishing to organise virtual exchange and virtual learning projects in cooperation with international partner institutions. The term "Virtual Exchange" comprises a range of different formats, where international students collaborate in a virtual setting and with the help of digital tools on specific assignments. Examples of such formats include Virtual Global Classroom, Collaborative Online International Learning (COIL) , and Blended Intensive Programmes (BIP) . Objectives of Virtual Exchange to establish new formats of digital learning and teaching, to expand those already at hand, and to strengthen international networks to improve the possibilities for non-mobile students to participate in international exchange and to promote intercultural sensitivities among all participants further development of digital and methodological skills in online learning in an international context sustainable establishment of our academic strategy „Internationalisation at Home“ and advancement of our local education program Click here to find more information about COIL and BIP: Collaborative Online International Learning (COIL) Blended Intensive Programmes (BIP)

title: Studying abroad
main_content: Studying abroad Spending time abroad at one of our 170 partner universities is a great way to offers a new study experience and is a great way to get to know to foreign culture, its people and everyday life. Experience abroad will also expand your horizon and help you to create a strong individual profile. We will gladly advise you on the many options for studying abroad and provide support with the organisation. You can read all the information about studying abroad in this presentation , as well as in our guide . ATTENTION: We will be on summer vacation from July 25, 2025, to August 18, 2025. title: Refugees: Pathways into studying
main_content: Refugees: Pathways into studying Table of contents Study selection and study funding Refugees can obtain information from the Student Services Centre about study opportunities, admission requirements and the application process the Students' Union (AStA) about financing their studies. Self-assessment fore refugees The self-assessment for study orientation for refugees provides you with Basic information about the requirements for studying Insights into daily student life Tips for successfully studying Video interviews with students The online self-assessment does not provide personalised answers about whether you will receive admission for a study programme or which specific conditions you do not yet fulfil. If you have questions about applications and admission, please contact the Student Service Centre of HTW Berlin . Applying for admission as a guest listener HTW Berlin invites refugees to attend courses as guest listeners ( Gasthörer ). Download the Application for admission as a guest listener [PDF]. Complete the form as required, ensuring that is clearly legible, and then take it to the teacher of the module for signature and written permission. Submit the fully completed form which has been signed by the teacher to the Students Management . After you have received confirmation of your admission as a guest listener, submit this immediately to the teacher of the module you wish to attend. As a guest listener at HTW Berlin, you can obtain a certificate of participation for guest listeners and guest students for the modules for which you are registered. You can then gain accreditation for the modules you participated in and any examinations, e.g. in order to apply for a study place. Applying for a study place If you have a higher education entrance qualification from abroad, your application for a programme of study will be pre-checked by uni-assist . Please submit all necessary application documents by the following dates: for summer semester by 31 December for winter semester by 30 June Address HTW Berlin c/o uni-assist e.V. D-11507 Berlin uni-assist will assess whether your foreign certificates meet the standards of the Standing Conference of the Ministers of Education and Cultural Affairs (Central Office for Foreign Education / Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen – ZaB) and are sufficient for admission to higher education in Germany. In some cases a school-leaving certificate granting admission to higher education in the applicant’s country of origin is sufficient to apply directly for a programme of study in Germany. However, it is often the case that additional qualifications must be demonstrated, e.g. proof of successfully completed academic years. If you are unable to provide all of your certificates from your country of origin, uni-assist will forward your application to HTW Berlin after you have proven your refugee status with a copy of your residence permit. HTW Berlin will then decide whether your application can be considered. If the pre-check performed by uni-assist determines that your foreign education certificates do not give you direct entitlement to study at HTW Berlin, you can apply for a preparatory course called a Studienkolleg (indirect entitlement to study). Participants of the HTW Integra Programme only can claim a reimbursement for application expenses. Residence permits If you are applying for a programme of study or as a guest listener, please submit one of the following documents: Copy of your certificate of registration as an asylum seeker ( Bescheinigung über die Meldung als Asylsuchender — BÜMA ) or Copy of your temporary residence permit ( Aufenthaltsgestattung ) in accordance with Section 55 AsylVfG in conjunction with Section 63 AsylVfG or Copy of your residence title granted on the basis of international law, humanitarian or political grounds as defined in sections 22 to 26 of the German Residence Act ( AufenthG ) or Copy of a refugee travel document, based on Article 28 of the Geneva Convention or Copy of temporary suspension of deportation ( Duldung ) as defined in Section 60a of the German Residence Act ( AufenthG ). Central Library Guest students can register as external users at the library: https://bibliothek.htw-berlin.de/en/about-us/how-to-use-the-library/

title: HTW Foundation: Advantages
main_content: HTW Foundation: Advantages Advantages of attending HTW Berlin as you start your university career Renommee : With 14,000 students, HTW Berlin is the largest University of Applied Sciences in Berlin, whose quality of education is confirmed in r ankings regularly and where international students can choose the suitable study programme from more than 75 degree programmes in the fields of technology, information technology, business, law, culture, and design. Internationality : HTW Berlin offers a lively international learning environment with over 3,000 international students from around 120 nations and around 150 partner universities abroad. Practice-orientation : Teaching at HTW Berlin is practice-oriented and learning groups are small. This facilitates academic success, intensifies contact between students and with lecturers and actively prepares students for their careers. Counselling and support : The comprehensive range of services at HTW Berlin supports international students in all relevant areas: Career planning, learning strategies, psychological counselling, subject-based supplementary courses, etc. Leisure time : University sports, student initiatives and the cultural and leisure activities in and around Berlin offer something for everyone's taste. The HTW Foundation Programme gives prospective students a structured, in-depth introduction to studying in Germany and specifically at HTW Berlin. Advantages of attending HTW Foundation as you prepare for your studies Enrolling in the fee-based HTW Foundation Programme offers you: the ideal professional, linguistic and intercultural preparation for studying in Germany as well as access to the academic job market personal support and counselling as you settle down and study in Germany German language skills and university-level study skills Request online consultation Request more information
